Hugo Chavez and Russia Northern Fleet claim United States tested Earthquake-Tectonic weapon on Haiti and it plans to use it on Iran this article was from 2010.

#ufotwitter

A Venezuelan state-run TV channel (ViVe TV, described as a "Hugo Chavez mouthpiece") published a story alleging that the U.S. had tested an experimental "earthquake weapon" or "shockwave system" that triggered the Haiti quake.

It cited an alleged report from Russia's Northern Fleet and tied it to the U.S. HAARP program in Alaska—a real but unclassified ionospheric research facility often targeted by conspiracy theories.

The claims extended further:

The Haiti event was supposedly a "test run."

The ultimate goal was using similar weapons to cause earthquakes that would destabilize Iran.

The same "weapon" could allegedly manipulate weather to cause floods, droughts, or hurricanes.

I have said many times that no one can defeat the United States and Russia, because since the 1950s they have had and created all kinds of unconventional vehicles and weapons.

Of course, it was the Russians who told them that. The Russians themselves and the Russian Ministry of Defense publicly stated in 2012 that they possess such weapons and many others, in addition to geophysical ones.

The only unknown in this equation is whether the Israelis and Iranians have any of these weapons.
